sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Rheumatic pain in right shoulder
joint, deltoid, and biceps. S^^elling, heat, redness of
joints. Spot of inflammation and redness over affected
joint. Pain severe and drawing. Chorea-like spasms ;
legs feel floating in air. Housemaid's knee. [Rhus;
Kali hyd.: Slag.] Shooting pains in knees. Joints arid
neighboring muscles red, swollen, painful. Rheumatic
pains precede catarrhal .symptoms.
